title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body: That middle one lives or dies based on how interesting and well depicted the virtual world is. It could be really great or it could be really awful, I don't think you can judge it yet.

The last one "immortal whispers" has a great chance to become more than just a one and done and reel in the viewer. However, the story as always must be complete in its depth so that the movie has a firm foundation
I’m genuinely curious if this is some kind of awkward, unfunny attempt at trolling or if you’re genuinely just weirdly obsessed with getting people’s opinions on these vague script premises.
